items.summary: Reviewer decision: reject the proposed allthingsmasonic.com execution because the site has active homepage work, overlapping queued affiliate work, incomplete site-level revenue attribution, and low-volume outcome evidence. No new implementation candidate clears all gates this cycle. Preserve the capacity gate. Domain-manager must reconcile active-work overlap by 2026-10-03T17:00Z; principal-engineer must document the canonical admission ledger and release at most one candidate only if baseline, threshold, tests, attribution, rollback, and release evidence pass. Site-factory must complete preview-only launch-readiness evidence for scaffold candidates; CTO must document operations/security evidence. Escalate unresolved blockers to the owner by the same deadline. No revenue, ROI, causal-lift, production-readiness, security-clearance, or deployment claim is supported.
